text: For an abelian group A, the second cohomology H²(G, A) classifies group ___ of G by A, i.e. sequences 0 → A → E → G → 1.
explanation: A 2-cocycle records the failure of a set-theoretic section G → E to be a homomorphism, and cohomologous cocycles give equivalent extensions; the zero class is the semidirect (or direct) product. H¹ similarly classifies crossed homomorphisms/derivations.
